## 1. Urgent Open Items (weight ≥ 0.65)

| Item | Action | Deadline |
|------|--------|----------|
| **Virtual‑context paging ↔ recall interference** (0.68) | Implement MemGPT‑style paging for the rewrite baseline; evaluate QA accuracy at > 40 items. | May 10 |
| **Paging + periodic consolidation** (0.65) | Add consolidation layer to the paging pipeline; compare against naive append. | May 12 |
| **Rewrite vs append ablation** (0.65) | Finalise experimental protocol; integrate benchmark tests. | May 14 |

> Draft: “Will add a paging + consolidation run to the ablation suite. Expect to hit the 40‑item recall target and clarify the rewrite advantage.”

> **Overnight idea**: Using MemGPT’s virtual context paging as the naive‑append baseline gives an isolated, reproducible control that satisfies the ICLR ablation request and yields a reusable benchmark for the workshop.

## 2. Workshop Paper (co‑author Maya)

- **Status**: Outline received, no rush.  
- **Next step**: Submit a short reply to Maya adding the MemGPT paging baseline and periodic consolidation to the experimental plan.  
- **Deadline**: May 8.

> Draft: “Thanks for the outline. I suggest we embed the MemGPT paging baseline and a consolidation module as part of the benchmark; this will address the reviewer’s ablation concern and strengthen the workshop contribution.”
